notes: Five roles were run sequentially in one context (disclosed; not independent). The DA-CRITICAL criteria are written for empirical papers (leakage, contradicting evidence); none names an incorrect proof, so I mapped proof-step failures that void the main theorems to criterion 1 ('evidence contradicts the main claim'), which is a judgment call. The script's composite cross-check (band 2) disagreed with the rating starting point (3) while both sat near a boundary; the EIC guidance on keeping the starting point worked but is subjective. related_search.py refuses queries over 4 concept words, so claim queries had to be shortened and two returned off-topic results; the tool prints long JSON that had to be filtered with grep. Phase 1.6 asks the Synthesizer to check weaknesses before the EIC, but the same single context wrote both the reports and the check. The 'novelty' command needs hand-written entailment levels, which is subjective. Equation extraction was partly garbled (Eq. 7 and several exponents), so some checks are marked partly unverifiable.
